children.counts: Simple counts of 4 beats per movement
children.game_version: Balance a single plastic cup with water or empty, focus on slow arm movements

seniors.counts: Simplified counts focusing on steady breathing and arm control
seniors.seated_version: Balance one glass on a stable surface while practicing arm movements
seniors.standing_version: Use one glass and perform slow arm lifts without spins

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Palms face upward balancing three full wine glasses; movements include spins and tilts
movement_profile.footwork: Not described in sources beyond basic stepping forward and backward
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo or line formation with sufficient space for arm movements
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Minimal hip movement; torso remains steady to maintain balance
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: No jumps; focus on balance and control
movement_profile.posture: Arms extended with palms facing upward, back straight, head held high

signature_moves.description: A slow spin with arms extended, balancing glasses without spilling
signature_moves.name: Glass Balancing Spin

signature_moves.description: Gentle tilting of the hands to demonstrate control over the glasses
signature_moves.name: Tilting Gesture

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Controlled and steady to avoid spilling
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Spilling the glasses Sudden or jerky movements that disrupt balance

music_profile.sound_description: Traditional Filipino folk music with rhythmic patterns that support the dancers' timing and balance.

basic_steps: Extend arms with palms facing upward, balancing three full wine glasses on each hand
Perform slow, controlled spins while maintaining balance
Tilt hands gently to demonstrate control without spilling
Step forward and backward carefully to maintain stability
Return to starting position with arms extended
teaching.formation: Typically performed solo or in a line, with dancers spaced to allow arm movements
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by balancing one glass before progressing to three; emphasis on arm steadiness and slow controlled movements
